root_cause.text: Lack of a speculation barrier (array_index_nospec) before using a user-controlled index to dereference a function pointer table in drm_compat_ioctl, enabling Spectre v1 speculative out-of-bounds access.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `nr = array_index_nospec(nr, ARRAY_SIZE(drm_compat_ioctls));` (from include/linux/nospec.h) after the bounds check, explicitly preventing speculative execution from using an out-of-bounds index into the `drm_compat_ioctls` function pointer array. The CVE description and commit message both describe the path as taking a user-controlled pointer (the cmd argument) and dereferencing it into a table of function pointers, which is the classic Spectre v1 pattern.
